verdicts.reason: Both are the same uniformly shrunk copy of the square original. The grey background panel doesn't reach the top or bottom of the canvas, which leaves mismatched lighter textured bands (about 75px each) that look like a rendering error. Nothing has been re-laid out for the taller format. The text is smaller than in the original, and the event line and address are now small. B only sits a few pixels lower than A, so they're effectively identical.
